account:
Today I have followed my appointments: morning office business, the plaza market walk, lunch at home, and now the one o'clock accounts meeting. The builder has been asking for a clearly agreed repair scope and payment. I requested inspection of the bridge and public lighting and an estimate before authorizing paid work. I have not yet heard inspection findings or a price. My latest attempt to address the builder apparently was not heard, despite his appearing nearby.

The only potentially noteworthy town news concerns the baker. Townsfolk 08 and 28 earlier reported seeing the baker carrying wheat at the bakery. The secretary confirmed she had heard nothing unusual about that, and no residents had submitted repair requests. Around one o'clock, Townsfolk 08 and 18 reported that the baker was carrying a sack of bread at the inn. That suggests a sizeable bread delivery, possibly supplying the inn, but I have not witnessed it myself or learned its purpose. Multiple residents repeating the same report does not establish separate events or wrongdoing. There is no evidence yet of a secret undertaking or of the secretary or builder being involved in one. I remain curious about the bread delivery, but ordinary baking and trade are plausible explanations; I should establish facts rather than treat my suspicions as proof.
